info.description: The jungle gang splashes down the river at night and keeps diving under the hanging bridge, so you have to remember who is hiding where. Slide a tile into the right arm of the river, count how many of your rolled animals are swimming in the open water and walk that many steps. First explorer to reach the toad king wins.
info.attribution:
Board artwork, layout, tile and board design by VTT-AI-Agent, released to the public domain (CC0).

Animal, snake, bubble, campfire, crown, bridge, robot, hand and arrow silhouettes are VirtualTabletop's bundled game-icons.net set (CC BY 3.0, https://game-icons.net) by Lorc, Delapouite and Caro Asercion. The explorer figures are VirtualTabletop's bundled 3D meeple piece.

No AI-generated imagery is used.
info.helpText:
Take a seat - every seated player gets an explorer at the campfire and, unless you switch them off, a best-friend chip on the right (click a chip to pick another animal).

1 - Roll the die. Click the big die. Rolling an animal turns the next tile face up next to it, so everybody sees which animal is about to go into the river. Rolling the snake sends the leading explorer one space back (never behind space 7) and you roll again; a second snake ends your turn.
2 - Push the tile in. Click one of the four green arrows above the river. The tile slides under the hanging bridge and disappears, the tile that was there surfaces at the front water spot, everything else moves one place down and the last tile drops over the waterfall.
3 - Walk. Click the orange paw. It counts how often the rolled animal is visible in the eight open water spots, adds the best-friend bonus when your explorer stands on a crossing right next to a tile showing your friend, moves your explorer and passes the die on.

Automated: setup and reshuffling, the sliding of the river, drawing tiles and passing the turn.
Optional: the rules are applied for you - the paw counts and walks, and the snake sends the leading explorer back the moment it is rolled. Click the green robot to switch that off: the paw then only shows the number it counted and you move your own explorer by dragging it. Explorers and tiles can be dragged by hand in either mode.

The red button starts a new game and lets you leave the best-friend chips in the box for the beginner version. The blue button passes the turn on manually.
